kinds.label: Page or database
kinds.note: What is allowed on a page or database also covers the pages inside it. Notion decides which pages Minerva can reach at all: they are chosen when connecting Notion, and connecting again changes them. Where Notion does not show where a page sits, blocking an action anywhere in this connection also blocks it there.

operations.name: search
operations.title: Search pages
operations.description: Search the Notion pages and databases you may read, by title. Without text, lists recently edited ones. To get the next page, repeat the call with identical arguments plus the returned next_cursor. incomplete: true means Notion did not search everything.

operations.name: get_page
operations.title: Get page details
operations.description: Read the title, properties and place of one Notion page by id or link.

page_id: A Notion id, or a link to the page or database.

operations.name: read_page
operations.title: Read a page
operations.description: Read the content of one Notion page as Notion-flavored markdown, with its properties. Long pages are cut at max_chars and marked truncated; continue with offset. Links to child pages and databases, and mentions of pages, appear without their titles (use get_page or get_database to see one you may read). Content synced from other pages is hidden.

page_id: A Notion id, or a link to the page or database.

operations.name: get_database
operations.title: Get a database
operations.description: Read a Notion database: its data sources and their properties, with the options of select and status properties. Properties marked hidden are never shown or used by Minerva.

database_id: A Notion id, or a link to the page or database.

operations.name: query_database
operations.title: Query a database
operations.description: List rows of a Notion database, optionally with a Notion filter and sorts on properties that are not hidden. A database with several data sources needs data_source_id. Rows you may not read are left out. To get the next page, repeat the call with identical arguments plus the returned next_cursor.

database_id: A Notion id, or a link to the page or database.
data_source_id: A Notion id, or a link to the page or database.
filter: A Notion data source query filter.

operations.name: list_comments
operations.title: List comments
operations.description: List the open comments on a Notion page itself (not comments on text inside it). To get the next page, repeat the call with identical arguments plus the returned next_cursor.

page_id: A Notion id, or a link to the page or database.

operations.name: create_page
operations.title: Create a page
operations.description: Create a Notion page inside a page where you have create permission, with a title and optional content. Everyone who can see the parent page can see it. Text is Notion-flavored markdown without images, embeds, media, child page or database tags, synced blocks, or mentions of people.

parent_page_id: A Notion id, or a link to the page or database.

operations.name: create_database_row
operations.title: Add a database row
operations.description: Add a row to a Notion database where you have create permission. properties maps property names to values: text, numbers, true/false, dates ("2026-10-01" or {"start", "end"}), and existing select, multi-select and status options (see get_database). Relations, people, files and computed properties cannot be set. Notion automations on the database may make further changes. Text is Notion-flavored markdown without images, embeds, media, child page or database tags, synced blocks, or mentions of people.

database_id: A Notion id, or a link to the page or database.
data_source_id: A Notion id, or a link to the page or database.

operations.name: update_page_properties
operations.title: Update page properties
operations.description: Change properties of a Notion page where you have edit permission, with values as for create_database_row. A page outside a database has only its title. Notion automations may make further changes.

page_id: A Notion id, or a link to the page or database.

operations.name: edit_page
operations.title: Edit a page
operations.description: Replace text in a Notion page where you have edit permission. Each old text must appear exactly once in the page as read_page shows it; lines linking to child pages, databases or mentioned pages cannot be edited, and nothing can be deleted along with child pages. Text is Notion-flavored markdown without images, embeds, media, child page or database tags, synced blocks, or mentions of people.

page_id: A Notion id, or a link to the page or database.
edits: Text to replace, as read_page shows it.

operations.name: append_to_page
operations.title: Append to a page
operations.description: Add content at the end of a Notion page where you have edit permission. Text is Notion-flavored markdown without images, embeds, media, child page or database tags, synced blocks, or mentions of people.

page_id: A Notion id, or a link to the page or database.

operations.name: add_comment
operations.title: Add a comment
operations.description: Comment on a Notion page where you have comment permission. People following the page may be notified. Text is Notion-flavored markdown without images, embeds, media, child page or database tags, synced blocks, or mentions of people.

page_id: A Notion id, or a link to the page or database.
